read.en: MP Materials fell 3.5% on Oct 16 to $40.17 after failing at $42.51 and trading as low as $39.88. It remains below all its falling averages: the 5-day ($41.5), 10-day ($44.2), 30-day ($47.8), 100-day ($52.3) and 200-day ($56.3). MACD has been below its signal since Aug 31 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($46.99), and RSI is 32.
read.zh: MP Materials 10月16日在 $42.51 受阻，盘中低见 $39.88，收盘下跌 3.5%，报 $40.17。股价仍位于所有下行均线下方：5 日（$41.5）、10 日（$44.2）、30 日（$47.8）、100 日（$52.3）和 200 日均线（$56.3）。MACD 自 8月31日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$46.99），RSI 为 32。

read.en: The rebound stalled near the 5-day average and gave back most of Oct 15's gain, but the close held the $40 round number. Resistance is $41.5–41.6 (5-day average, Oct 15 close), then $44.2–44.5 (10-day average, Oct 1 low) and $47 (SAR, Sep 18 low). Support is $40, then $37.8 (Jul 29 52-week low) and $35. A close below $37.8 would set a new 52-week low.
read.zh: 反弹在 5 日均线附近受阻，回吐了 10月15日的大部分涨幅，但收盘守住 $40 整数关口。阻力为 $41.5–41.6（5 日均线、10月15日收盘价），其次 $44.2–44.5（10 日均线、10月1日低点）和 $47（SAR、9月18日低点）。支撑为 $40，其次 $37.8（7月29日 52 周低点）和 $35。若收盘跌破 $37.8，将创 52 周新低。
